jobs_results.title: Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
Sipay is looking for a Python Developer with experience between 1 and 3 years. Its objective will be to develop new projects in the API in addition to continuing the current projects.

In your day to day work with the most modern technologies ...Python3.6+ (We have projects in version 3.8)OpenAPI3Our APIs are GraphQL and REST, and we are experts in integrating with third party APIs.
We work with microservices philosophy.

We integrate with third-party HTTP APIs, we produce our own APIs and we integrate with non-http protocols, so we will value knowledge both in integrations with APIs and in modeling them.
When deploying, we use Jenkins, Docker and to package you will work with pypoetry.
What do we expect from you?A committed, proactive profile with a strong focus on problem solving.
Open mind and focused on continuous innovation.#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: XC-093 - Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a mid / senior Python Developer

Responsibilities :
Maintenance and development of the backend of an e-commerce application based on Django Rest Framework

Writing unit tests for new functionalities

Delivering readable and transparent code

Building dashboards based on SQL queries and processing the results

Direct contact with the client

Requirements :
Minimum 3 years of experience working with Python

Knowledge of Django, Django Rest Framework, Docker, Docker-compose, relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL), Flask, Redis, Celery, postgresql

English at least B2

Understanding the right patterns and algorithms

Practical analytical skills

Nice to have :
Kubernetes, graphql, AWS / Google Cloud as well as Agile / SCRUM / Kanban

We offer :
B2B contract type

Full-time job

Remote and flexible working hours

jobs_results.description:

Senior Python Developer at Exo Investing

Madrid,Spain Jul 09, 2018

Read Interview about Exo Investing

For our Madrid office, we are looking for a Senior Python Developer to join our team in building awesome trading and rebalancing algorithms as well as integrations of third party APIs and FIX trading protocols. The ideal candidate should be proficient in Python 3, Django and be very familiar with SQL databases, Redis, REST APIs and Amazon Web Services.

As a young company we are looking for people who are self-starters with a can-do attitude and an entrepreneurial mindset. As our team is still small, you will have to wear a lot of different hats - but it also means that you can specialise in a field you enjoy and become the expert in your area.

We value diversity in educational backgrounds and all other aspects of life. As long as you enjoy learning new... things, we really want to hear from you.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact our CEO Lennart ) or CTO Antonio ) directly.

Our technology stack- Python 3- Django- PostgreSQL- Celery- Redis- AWS EC2, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS- Ansible

Our company language is English.

Requiremets

Key responsibilitiesIntegration of user-facing elements developed by front-end developers with server side logic.Implementation of security and data protection.Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system.

Development tasks- Developing RESTful APIs.- Creating a global flexible configurable architecture- Integrating third-party APIs.- Working with task queues such as Celery.- Using AWS services- Automating testing with PyTest.- In Git, working with branches and rebases.- Implementing security best practices

BenefitsAs a young and growing startup that is also a co-venture between two world-class players in their fields, we combine the best of two worlds: access to the resources of strong partners and the agile environment to really make a difference.

Our technical development team is based in Madrid, all operating functions are based in the heart of the City in London. Both environments offer all the flexibility and perks that you expect from a small but quickly growing firm.

At our Madrid location, we will also treat you to the following:
• On-site chef for lunch.
• A breakfast kitchen and fruit during the day.
• A budget for your equipment.
• Access to personal and professional learning resources.
Position: Employee Work Schedule: Full-time Remote: No Relocation: No Salary: Not Specified How to Apply

Position is expired. Thanks for your interest.
